# Vadaanya Janaa Society

> From Dreams to Degrees — bridging the gap between a government-school child's potential and a degree.

## About

Vadaanya Janaa Society is a registered non-profit organization (Reg. No. 1433/2010) established in November 2010 in Hyderabad, India. The society is certified under 80G and 12A of the Indian Income Tax Act, making donations tax-deductible.

Founded by Ashok Padapati, the organization began when a group of friends committed to donating 0.5% of their monthly salaries to support underprivileged government school children. Over 15 years, this initiative has grown into a statewide community non-profit serving 12 districts across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

## Founder & Leadership Profile

**Ashok Padapati** — Founder & President, Vadaanya Janaa Society

- **Background & Roots**: Born and raised in Kothacheruvu village, Anantapur district, Andhra Pradesh. Growing up in a rural region and studying in government schools inspired his lifelong dedication to educational equity and social entrepreneurship.
- **Education**: B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from SASTRA University (2006–2010).
- **Professional Career**: Over 16+ years of IT industry experience in Quality Assurance (QA) leadership:
  - Lead Quality Assurance Engineer at OpenText, Hyderabad (2025–Present)
  - QA Lead at NCR Voyix (2018–2025)
  - Quality Specialist at HCL Technologies (2010–2018)
- **Founding Philosophy & 0.5% Model**: In 2010, while starting his software engineering career, Ashok rallied a group of colleagues to contribute 0.5% of their monthly salaries to educate government school children. Operating with a zero-overhead volunteer model, 100% of public donations directly fund student scholarships, digital tools, and competitive exam coaching.
- **Global Mentorship & ISF Junicorn**: Serves as a student mentor with the International Startup Foundation (ISF) for the Junicorn programme, guiding first-generation and rural student entrepreneurs. In May 2025, Ashok accompanied a cohort of young founders to the United States, where students presented their startup pitch decks at Texas State University.
- **LinkedIn Profile**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashok-padapati-67277b50/

## Mission

To improve the living standards of the destitute and needy through education — ensuring every child with a will to learn gets the chance to succeed, from Class 10 through post-graduation.

## Key Programs

- **Srinivasa Ramanujan Talent Test (Vadaanya Talent Test)**: A statewide scholarship examination for government school students (Classes 8–10), endorsed by the AP Education Ministry, conducted across 12 districts.
- **Scholarships & Financial Aid**: Direct financial support covering tuition, study materials, and living expenses from school through post-graduation (B.Tech, MBBS, CA, B.Sc).
- **Digital Empowerment & Infrastructure**: Provision of laptops, digital learning equipment, and study tools for meritorious first-generation learners.
- **Mentorship & Career Guidance**: Weekend sessions with industry leaders, civil servants, software engineers, and corporate executives.
- **Government Exam Preparation**: Free coaching, mock tests, and physical fitness training for Railway, Police, and Teaching competitive exams.
- **School Adoption**: Upgrading government schools with digital learning infrastructure and adaptive resources.

## Impact (Key Statistics)

- 15,000+ students evaluated through the Vadaanya Talent Test
- 400+ scholarships and stipends awarded
- 180+ digital learning tools & equipment provided to first-generation learners
- 15+ years of continuous operation (since 2010)
- Active across 12 districts in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana

## Recognition & Awards

- Conferred the **"Yuva Bharat Gaurav" Award** by Bharatiya Vikas Sangam for youth leadership and social service

- **Special Invitee** to the Andhra Pradesh Governor's Raj Bhavan "At Home" event
